title: Prove exact total tape traffic for PR2753 linear sign
body:
PR2753's linear sign already has an endpoint proof, exact source-movement checks and a 3B residue-counter setup control. This adds an independently derived, all-parameter invoice for **every logical Tape/Word read, write and unit movement** during the successful sign interval, including numerical setup/disposal and all countdown setup, normalization, decrement and cleanup. The written proof gives a conservative **T < 2048V** bound on canonical Ring inputs.

A complete countdown costs `15n + 14d - 5 popcount(n) + 36` for n>0, with a separate zero case. Composing the literal loops yields the exact total formula. An endpoint-preserving padded-two mutation raises one fixture from 24,454 to 35,353 operations while keeping its 386 source movements unchanged; the total-cost gate detects it. Padded residue width demonstrates the necessity of the canonical-width premise and is rejected by the production Ring constructor.

All changes are confined to `research/linear-sign-total-traffic/`: proof, separate arithmetic formulas, authenticated predecessor exports, portable checker, fixed receipt and task/replay metadata. David Arias / PR2753 head `7dba5452a4071a856a0b11cebdcd2d3b6bcd7659` and Jose Manuel / PR2697 retain algorithm and predecessor-check credit. Original notices are preserved. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed; no human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14: registered normal and optimized replay pass, covering 387 countdowns, 150 signs / 24,624 addresses, provenance and restoration, malformed inputs, width/counter/endpoint/source/typed-receipt controls. Git-free optimized CPython 3.14.7 replay, read-only inventory of all 20 package files, publication-byte preflight and diff checks pass. No full selected cold replay, physical compiler, complete caller/H2, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

Task `supplier-boundary-audit`, refined to this local time obligation; picker nonce `dbd1c5cd78cdfc2470dc907fd989ab72`, priority revision 5. Started at main `4b82082f901945f8d0314f143576c7ad31e021fc`, rebased onto refreshed canonical main `c7df0bb890cae0cc393cdd32dad19c3facc80992`; guidance, selected record and predecessor head were unchanged. Final overlap covered 491 open PRs and 1,522 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Exact timestamps, source pins, limitations and open next questions are in the package. [Canonical investigation/claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18965676).

Reproduce:
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/linear-sign-total-traffic
```
